items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: he came in and he wanted to hear a Miles Davis recording.

ctx.x: Yes. People do come in and use it. And I was shocked one day when somebody came in, just one of the community people in the Newark community – because we’re open to everybody, we’re not just open to students, it’s open to everybody – he came in and he wanted to hear a Miles Davis recording. But he said, “I don’t want to hear the CD, I want to hear the LP.” And so I did a double take and said, “You sure? I mean it’s the same record.” “No, no, no” he said, “I want to hear the LP. The LP sounds different.” So I got…
Oh right. They’re not going to make them anymore.
